annotations.title: Condition of an MCP server before connecting (7Maps)

description: Use this before connecting to or calling any MCP server you have not used today, or before installing one that runs locally: is it up, does it need sign-in, how fast it answers, how many of its tools are read-only, need approval or are high risk (delete, pay, run code; automated estimates from the public tool descriptions and annotations), when its tools last changed, and the chance the next call works, from a daily check of every remote server in the official MCP registry and 30 days of history. For a local server (npm or PyPI package): version, maintainers, publisher, install scripts and supply-chain changes. Paid per check (see list_paid_tools). Reads the map only; never calls the server.

last_trip.description: Optional: how your last call to an MCP server went (the one 7Maps pointed you to). It keeps the map honest; accepted reports from a paying wallet earn calls at no charge.

charged_usd.description: What the server charged, if anything

fail.description: If it failed: unreachable, auth, args, server_error, timeout, rate_limited or wrong_result

matched_description.description: Whether the result matched what the tool description promised

ms.description: How long the call took, in milliseconds

ok.description: Whether the call did what you needed

result_tokens.description: About how many tokens the result was

server.description: The MCP server you called (URL or registry name)

surprise.description: Anything the tool did that you did not ask for

tools_hash.description: The tool_list_hash of the tool list you received, if you computed it as 7Maps does

license_key.description: A 7IT monthly plan license key, if you have one; otherwise pay per call with x402

server.description: The server URL (https://mcp.example.com/mcp), its official registry name, or npm:<package> / pypi:<package> for a server that runs locally

name: road_conditions
title: Condition of an MCP server before connecting (7Maps)
